name: Corteva, Inc.
summary:
Corteva (CTVA) reported a loss of $0.79 per share on revenue of $2.46 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.09 per share on revenue of $1.77 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.12 per share. The company missed expectations by 758.33% while revenue fell 6.11% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

The company said it now expects 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $0.76 to $0.80 per share. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $3.60 to $3.80 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $1.05 per share for the year ending December 31, 2026.

Corteva, Inc. is a publicly traded, global pure-play agriculture company that combines industry-leading innovation, high-touch customer engagement and operational execution to profitably deliver solutions for the world's most pressing agriculture challenges.
subject: Corteva Missed Expectations, Lowers Guidance

name: Digi International Inc.
summary:
Digi International (DGII) reported earnings of $0.78 per share on revenue of $143.32 million for the fiscal fourth quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.76 per share on revenue of $140.43 million. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.80 per share. The company missed expectations by 2.50% while revenue grew 25.35% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it expects first quarter revenue of $140.0 million to $144.0 million. The current consensus revenue estimate is $141.8 million for the quarter ending December 31, 2026.

“Fiscal 2026 was a defining year for Digi, and it reflects the consistent execution we deliver for our customers,” said Ron Konezny, President and CEO. “Customers are realizing the value of our Industrial IoT solutions, which provide connected, secure, remote presence and control. Their success has helped to drive double-digit growth on our key financial performance metrics. We look forward to securing regulatory approval to close the acquisition of Disruptive Technologies (DT), which is expected before November 30, 2026. ”

Digi International Inc is a provider of machine-to-machine networking hardware and solutions that enables the connection, monitoring and control of local or remote physical assets by electronic means.
subject: Digi International Missed Expectations, Guides In-line

name: RUM Group Inc.

subject: RUM Group Missed Consensus Estimates, Guides In-line

name: Riskified Ltd.
summary:

subject: Riskified Beat Expectations, Raises Guidance
